function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT period, vendor_id, sku, SUM((unit_price_orig - contract_unit_price) * qty * fx_rate) AS excess_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
WHERE period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
AND unit_price_orig > contract_unit_price
GROUP BY period, vendor_id, sku
ORDER BY period, vendor_id, sku","purpose":"Aggregate excess CAD by period, vendor, sku where unit price > contract price"}
